```{r}
library(readxl)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggstatsplot)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

#### comedication based on gender ####
### comedication_male ###

```{r}
gender_data <- read_excel("E:\\Daten(x)\\Daten(lw-r)\\Abc\\Doktorarbeit SJS\\Analyse R-Statistics\\gender plots\\gender_info_full.xlsx",
           skip = 1 )
gender_data
```

```{r}
gender_data %>% 
mutate(Male = ifelse(Male == 1, "M", Male),
       Female = ifelse(Female == 1, "F",Female)) 
```

```{r}
gender_data_clean <- gender_data %>%
  mutate(
    gender = case_when(
      Male == 1 ~ "M",
      Female == 1 ~ "F",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_  
    )
  ) %>% 
  drop_na(gender) %>% 
  dplyr::select(1,2,5) %>% 
  dplyr::rename("bfarm_nummer" = "Edited_BfArM Nummer2")
gender_data_clean
```

```{r}
comedicationdata <- read_csv("comedication_full_data.csv")
comedicationdata1 <- comedicationdata %>% 
  dplyr::rename( "patient_group" = "treatment",
                 "parameter_co" = "labreads",
                 "kathegorie_co" = "kathegorie",
                 "drug_group_co" = "drug_group")

comedicationdata1
```




```{r}
comedication_male_data <- left_join(gender_data_clean,comedicationdata1, by = "bfarm_nummer") %>% 
  dplyr::filter(gender == "M") %>% 
  drop_na(patient_group)
 
comedication_male_data
 
comedication_female_data <- left_join(gender_data_clean,comedicationdata1, by = "bfarm_nummer") %>% 
  dplyr::filter(gender == "F") %>%
  drop_na(patient_group)
 
comedication_female_data
```
 
 ### Male ####################################################################
 
```{r}
male_comed_data <- comedication_male_data %>%
  distinct(bfarm_nummer, Medication) %>% 
  group_by(bfarm_nummer) %>% 
  summarise(comedication = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  group_by(comedication) %>% 
  summarise(male_patient_num_per_med = n(), .groups = "drop")
 
male_comed_data
 
# Step 2: Get distinct patient-medication pairs
distinct_male_data <-  comedication_male_data %>%
  distinct(bfarm_nummer, Medication)
 
# Step 3: Create a list based on the actual `comedication` values from male_comed_data
medication_groups_male <- map(male_comed_data$comedication, function(n) {
  distinct_male_data %>%
    group_by(bfarm_nummer) %>%
    filter(n() == !!n) %>%
    arrange(bfarm_nummer)
})
 
# Step 4: Name the list elements based on the number of meds
names(medication_groups_male) <- paste0("patients_with_", male_comed_data$comedication, "_meds")
 
# Example: show patients with 2 medications
medication_groups_male$patients_with_2_meds
```
 
```{r}
medication_sets_male <- map(medication_groups_male, ~ unique(.x$Medication))
 
```
 
 
 
```{r}
group_names_male <- names(medication_sets_male)
 
pairwise_combinations_male <- combn(group_names_male, 2, simplify = FALSE)
 
```
 
 
```{r}
library(VennDiagram)
library(ggvenn)
library(qPCRtools)


dir.create("venn_plots_male", showWarnings = FALSE)
 
for (pair in pairwise_combinations_male) {
  group1 <- pair[1]
  group2 <- pair[2]
 
  meds1 <- medication_sets_male[[group1]] %>% na.omit()
  meds2 <- medication_sets_male[[group2]] %>% na.omit()
 
  # Skip if either set is empty
  if (length(meds1) == 0 || length(meds2) == 0) {
    message("Skipping: ", group1, " vs ", group2, " (empty set)")
    next
  }
 
  venn.diagram(
    x = setNames(list(meds1, meds2), c(group1, group2)),
    filename = paste0("venn_plots_male/", group1, "_vs_", group2, ".png"),
    output = TRUE,
    category.names = c(group1, group2),
    fill = c("blue", "yellow"),
    alpha = 0.5,
    cex = 1.5,
    fontface = "bold",
    cat.cex = 1.5,
    cat.fontface = "bold",
    cat.pos = c(-15, 15),
    cat.dist = c(0.05, 0.05),
    cat.just = list(c(0.5, 1), c(0.5, 1)),
    margin = 0.1
  )
 
  message("✅ Saved Venn diagram: ", group1, " vs ", group2)
}
 
```


```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Sicherstellen, dass medication_count numerisch sortierbar ist
males_per_medcount <- male_comed_data %>%
  arrange(comedication)

count_of_males_per_comedication_intake <- ggplot(males_per_medcount, aes(x = comedication, y = male_patient_num_per_med)) +
  geom_col() +
  theme_classic() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0("N = ", male_patient_num_per_med)),
    vjust = -0.3,  # Positionierung leicht oberhalb des Balkens
    size = 3       # Optional: kleinere Schriftgröße
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Count of males per Comedication Intake", 
    x = "Comedication Count", 
    y = "Males Count"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = males_per_medcount$comedication  # Alle Werte anzeigen
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5)
  )

dir.create("plots_male and female comedication count", showWarnings = FALSE)
svg("plots_male and female comedication count/count_of_males_per_comedication_intake.svg", height = 8, width = 12)
print(count_of_males_per_comedication_intake)
dev.off()
```
